skill.name: flops-compute-prices
skill.description: Look up and cite public GPU and accelerator rental reference prices from the FLOPS Index.

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives in context. The Python helper makes documented requests only to a fixed FLOPS Index endpoint and forwards only its optional named key to that endpoint.

content.value_statement: GPU rental prices vary by chip and market type. This skill retrieves FLOPS Index reference rates, compares options, and provides verifiable citations.
actual_capabilities: Retrieves public reference prices for FLOPS Index slugs.
Lists, searches, compares, and verifies compute-price indices.
Produces citation and verification links with timestamp caveats.
limitations: Prices are delayed indicative reference levels, not live provider quotes.
The public index does not identify individual compute providers.
A lowest DePIN rate may not be comparable to a conventional cloud rate.
Network access to the FLOPS Index API is required for current results.

use_cases.title: Estimate GPU experiment costs
use_cases.description: Compare H100, A100, or H200 reference rates before planning a machine-learning run.

prompt_templates.title: Look up one GPU price
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the current FLOPS reference price for an H100 spot GPU. Include the as-of time and source link.

output_examples.input: What is the H100 spot reference price?
output_examples.output: A cited H100 spot reference rate with its UTC as-of bucket, delayed-data caveat, verification link, and source link.

best_practices: Include the UTC as-of time, delayed-reference caveat, and source link with every price.
Confirm a citable price through the authoritative price endpoint after catalog comparisons.
Label DePIN rates clearly and compare them separately from conventional cloud markets.
anti_patterns: Do not present a reference level as a live provider quote or settlement price.
Do not call a verification mismatch proof that a user price is wrong.
Do not compare a DePIN rate with an on-demand rate without explaining the market difference.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: No. Public delayed reference prices are available without an API key.

faq.question: Are these live cloud-provider prices?
faq.answer: No. They are delayed indicative FLOPS Index reference levels.
